label: d3_sglang_counter_probe
stage: diagnose (lead: explain the 1.0757 cross-check on e4_b300_sglang column B)
note: Why did SGLang's sglang:prompt_tokens_total grow 7.6% more than the prompt tokens its responses reported (e4_b300_sglang column B at 2.368 req/s; ~1.10 against arrival-time counting at both rates; no retractions)? Same SGLang v0.5.23 image and ModelOpt checkpoint as e4, on a cheap RTX PRO 6000 (counter semantics are the engine's, not the GPU's). bench/counter_probe.py sends one request at a time and scrapes the counter before, mid-request and after (streaming and not, 500/2K/9.5K tokens); then one real-text cell at 0.35 req/s (under this card's ~0.44 req/s capacity) records the cross-check under load; then the probe again.

servers.name: sgl_nvfp4_nv
servers.launch: python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path /root/models/nvfp4_modelopt --served-model-name gemma --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --context-length 32768 --mem-fraction-static 0.88 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report --attention-backend triton --quantization modelopt_fp4
